title: Support

headings.text: The destination for all your support needs Log in to SCIEX Now
You have CE, LC, mass spec questions? SCIEX has the answers.
The Destination for All Your Support Needs.
SCIEX Now gives you everything you need

body: SCIEX support is the single destination for your mass spectrometry questions. We aim to fully assist you with virtually every application of our instruments, helping you to get the most out of your lab resources and assets.
Maximize your productivity, increase your uptime and accelerate the quality of your results with the SCIEX Now support network – the only team that can deliver all the support your lab needs.
Everything You Need, Anytime You Need It
Submit and manage support cases, track status and history
Access online training courses and Knowledge Base articles
Manage software licenses linked to your registered instruments
View and report critical instrument statistics when connected to StatusScope remote monitoring service
Be a part of the SCIEX community by submitting questions and comments
Receive notifications from SCIEX with content based on your preferences
Save your favorite content from the resource library
